camera_calibration_toolbox.core.camera_calibration.plot_reproj_error

camera_calibration_toolbox.core.camera_calibration.plot_reproj_error(per_view_err, image_indices, rms_reproj_error)[source]

Plot mean re-projection error and re-projection error for each calibration image.

Parameters

  • per_view_err – re-projection error for each image.

  • image_indices – Indices of the images that were used for calibration.

  • rms_reproj_error – The RMS re-projection error.
